title: [Cyberhaven] Incident logs not received in Datadog
description: Alerts when no Cyberhaven incident logs have been received in Datadog for 24 hours. Create it only if you stream Incidents.

definition.name: [Cyberhaven] Incident logs not received in Datadog
definition.message:
{{#is_alert}}
## Alert: Cyberhaven incident logs have not been received in Datadog for the last 24 hours.
`source:cyberhaven` `cyberhaven.logtype:cyberhaven-incidents`

Received `{{value}}` logs in the last 24 hours (alert threshold: `{{threshold}}`). Triggered at `{{last_triggered_at}}`.

### Impact
Incident (DLP detection) data is missing, delaying triage and response for risky data movement.

### Investigation

1. Open the **Cyberhaven - Troubleshooting** dashboard and review **Ingest Status** for the Incident source (last received time and volume).
2. In Log Explorer, search `source:cyberhaven`. If other log types are arriving but not incident logs, the issue is specific to this destination. If nothing is arriving, check the Datadog API key and site.
3. In the Cyberhaven Console under **Settings > Data Export > Destinations**, verify the URI includes `ddsource=cyberhaven` and `cyberhaven.logtype:cyberhaven-incidents`, the Datadog site is correct, **Format** is `JSON Array`, **Encoding** is `GZip`, and the `DD-API-KEY` header is set. Run **Save & Test**.
4. Under **Settings > Data Export**, verify the **Source** is `Incidents`, **Scope** is `Full Access`, **Subscribe to new incidents**, **Subscribe to incident updates** and **Include incident event details** are checked, **Schedule** is `Immediate`, and **Enabled** is checked.
5. Verify the Datadog API key is active and has not been revoked or expired (**Organization Settings > API Keys**).
6. Check Cyberhaven for streaming destination delivery failures, retries, or other delivery errors.
7. Verify that incidents were actually created in Cyberhaven during the window (Incidents page). If no policy matched, no incident logs are expected and this alert can be treated as informational.
8. If logs are arriving but not visible, check that no Datadog index exclusion filter is dropping them.

Please investigate and restore Cyberhaven → Datadog incident logs delivery.

{{/is_alert}}

{{#is_recovery}}
## Recovery: Cyberhaven incident logs delivery has recovered.

Cyberhaven incident logs are being received normally in Datadog. Received `{{value}}` logs in the last 24 hours.
{{/is_recovery}}
